docs.title: Rush.Moe Documentation
docs.text: Native Solana Web3 real-time chat application (EVM compatible)

docs.title: 🚀 Introduction
docs.text:
Rush.Moe is a native Solana Web3 real-time chat application (EVM compatible). Discovering Alpha and instant trading opportunities first is Rush's core philosophy.

Anyone can build their own Alpha channel on Rush.Moe (with options for paid/private channels, earning trading fees, supporting Solana & EVM NFT verification for private channel access). Voice chat further enhances real-time community communication efficiency.

Invite friends to join Rush.Moe and share channel creation fees & trading fees (upcoming feature).

docs.text: 

docs.title: 🎯 Core Philosophy
docs.text:
Discovering Alpha and instant trading opportunities first is Rush's core philosophy.

Rush.Moe enables users to: - Build and manage Alpha channels - Earn revenue from channel creation and trading fees - Access exclusive private channels through NFT verification - Communicate instantly through voice chat

docs.title: 🎯 Quick Start
docs.text:
# 1. Clone the project
git clone <repository-url>
cd RushChat

# 2. Install dependencies
npm install
cd client && npm install && cd ..

# 3. Create database
mysql -u root -p < database/schema.sql

# 4. Configure environment variables
cp docs/ENVIRONMENT_TEMPLATE.md .env

# 5. Start the application
cd server-rust && cargo run
cd ../client && npm start

Visit: http://localhost:3000

docs.title: Changelog
docs.text: This document records all version updates and feature changes of RushChat.

docs.title: Changelog Overview
docs.text: 

docs.title: New Features
docs.text:
• ✅ Channel System: Support for creating and managing private channels
  • ✅ Points System: User points management and channel creation costs
  • ✅ Wallet Address Verification: EVM and SOL address format validation
  • ✅ Rush Executive Privileges: Free channel creation, free access to private channels
  • ✅ Invitation System: Personalized invitation codes, share to X, QR code sharing
  • ✅ Custom Stickers: Users can upload GIF stickers (10 for regular users, 100 for admins and channel owners)
  • ✅ Sticker Duplicate Detection: Uses SHA256 hash to prevent duplicate uploads
  • ✅ Voice Chat Feature: WebRTC voice calls, supports multiple users, screen sharing, invitations, permission management
  • ✅ Red Packet System: EVM and Solana chain red packets, supports regular and random red packets
  • ✅ X402 Protocol: Implementation of Coinbase X402 payment protocol, supports on-chain payment verification
  • ✅ Wallet Verification Enhancement: Support for Metaplex Core NFT, DAS API, automatic RPC fallback

docs.title: Improvements
docs.text:
• ✅ Optimized user list deduplication logic
  • ✅ Improved session management to prevent duplicate logins
  • ✅ Enhanced real-time feedback for wallet address verification
  • ✅ Fixed Avatar Upload Issue: Changed avatar field from VARCHAR(500) to LONGTEXT to support storing large base64 image data
  • ✅ Image Compression Feature: Automatic image compression when uploading avatars to reduce data size
  • ✅ Unified file path logic: Ensures consistent file paths for uploads and serving
  • ✅ Optimized route order: Ensures specific routes take priority over generic static file serving
  • ✅ Solana NFT Verification Optimization: Uses getAssetsByOwner (DAS API) to support Metaplex Core NFT
  • ✅ RPC Endpoint Optimization: Defaults to Helius RPC, automatically detects DAS API support and falls back
  • ✅ Wallet Connection Optimization: Improved connection and switching logic for Phantom, OKX, and other wallets
  • ✅ Error Handling Enhancement: Global error handling, suppresses browser extension and wallet-related errors

docs.title: User System
docs.text:
• ✅ Guest Mode: No registration required, one-click entry to chat room
  • ✅ User Registration: Supports username, password, and email registration
  • ✅ User Login: Password verification login
  • ✅ Session Persistence: Automatically restores login state on page refresh
  • ✅ Reserved Word Protection: Usernames like admin, root must use password login

docs.title: Chat Functionality
docs.text:
• ✅ Real-time Messaging: WebSocket-based real-time communication
  • ✅ Text Messages: Supports plain text message sending
  • ✅ Image Sharing: Supports image upload and sharing (max 5MB)
  • ✅ Typing Indicator: Shows users who are typing
  • ✅ Online User List: Real-time display of online users
  • ✅ Message History: Automatically loads historical messages

docs.title: Permission Management
docs.text:
• ✅ Three-level Administrator System: A-level (Super Admin), B-level (Rush Executive), C-level (Admin)
  • ✅ IP Banning: Administrators can ban violating IPs (60 minutes)
  • ✅ User Muting: Administrators can temporarily mute users (15 minutes)
  • ✅ Administrator Appointment: Senior administrators can appoint junior administrators

docs.title: Channel System
docs.text:
• ✅ Public Channels: Default channels accessible to all users
  • ✅ Private Channels: Channels that require a password to join
  • ✅ Channel Creation:
  • Regular users: Requires 100,000 points, creation costs 50,000 points
  • Rush executives: Free creation, no points consumed
  • ✅ Channel Management: Channel owners can set/modify channel passwords
  • ✅ Channel Switching: Users can switch channels at any time
  • ✅ Message Isolation: Messages from different channels are isolated from each other

docs.title: User Profile
docs.text:
• ✅ Profile Management: Can set avatar, email, wallet address
  • ✅ Avatar Upload: Supports image upload (max 5MB)
  • ✅ Wallet Address:
  • EVM addresses (Ethereum, etc.): Format validation
  • SOL addresses (Solana): Format validation
  • ✅ Password Change: Supports changing login password

docs.title: Interface Design
docs.text:
• ✅ Slack-style: Modern chat interface design
  • ✅ Day/Night Mode: Supports theme switching
  • ✅ Responsive Design: Adapts to desktop and mobile devices
  • ✅ Multi-language Support: Chinese/English switching

docs.title: Frontend
docs.text:
• React 18 + Hooks
  • Socket.io Client
  • CSS Variables (Theme System)
  • React Context (State Management)
  • Real-time validation and feedback

docs.title: Backend
docs.text:
• Rust + Axum
  • Tokio WebSocket (WebSocket)
  • MySQL (Optional, supports in-memory mode)
  • bcrypt (Password encryption)
  • Session management

docs.title: Table Structure
docs.text:
• users: User table
  • messages: Message table
  • channels: Channel table
  • sessions: Session table
  • banned_ips: IP ban table
  • muted_users: Muted users table
  • admin_logs: Administrator operation log table

docs.title: Security Features
docs.text:
• Password encrypted storage (bcrypt)
  • Reserved word protection
  • IP banning mechanism
  • User muting mechanism
  • Administrator operation logs

Built with Rust, React, and MySQL ❤️

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: RushChat configuration is primarily done through environment variables.

docs.title: Configuration Overview
docs.text: 

docs.title: Backend Configuration
docs.text: Create a .env file in the project root directory (backend will prioritize loading the .env file in the project root).

docs.title: Basic Services
docs.text:
PORT=5001                    # Backend service port
NODE_ENV=development         # Environment mode: development | production
CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:3000  # Frontend address (for CORS)
MAIN_DOMAIN=localhost        # Main domain (set to actual domain in production)

docs.title: Database
docs.text:
DB_HOST=localhost            # Database host
DB_PORT=3306                 # Database port
DB_USER=root                 # Database username
DB_PASSWORD=your_password    # Database password
DB_NAME=rushchat             # Database name

docs.title: Solana RPC (Optional)
docs.text:
SOL_HTTP_RPC=https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com
SOL_RPC=https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com

docs.title: Red Packet Contracts (Optional)
docs.text:
# EVM chain red packet contract address
RED_PACKET_CONTRACT_ADDRESS=

# Solana red packet program ProgramId (Base58, typically 32~44 characters)
# Important: Must be "Program ProgramId", not wallet address
SOLANA_RED_PACKET_PROGRAM_ID=

docs.title: Frontend Configuration
docs.text:
Create a .env file in the client/ directory:

REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL=http://localhost:5001

docs.title: Database Configuration
docs.text: Database configuration is read from environment variables, no additional configuration file needed.

docs.title: Channel Rules Configuration
docs.text: Channel rules are stored in the database and configured through the admin interface or API.

docs.text:

DB_HOST=<railway_mysql_host>

docs.title: CORS Configuration
docs.text: Backend controls CORS allowed origins through the CLIENT_URL environment variable.

docs.title: Database Security
docs.text:
• Use strong passwords
  • Restrict database access IP
  • Regularly backup database

docs.title: Production Environment Recommendations
docs.text:
• Use HTTPS
  • Set strong password policy
  • Enable database SSL connection
  • Configure firewall rules

docs.title: Environment Variable Priority
docs.text:
Backend environment variable loading order:

  1. Project root directory .env file
  2. System environment variables
  3. Default values

docs.title: Check Environment Variables
docs.text:
# Backend
cd server-rust
cargo run -- --check-env

# Frontend
cd client
npm run check-env

docs.title: Test Database Connection
docs.text: mysql -u $DB_USER -p$DB_PASSWORD -h $DB_HOST -P $DB_PORT $DB_NAME -e "SELECT 1;"

docs.title: CORS Error
docs.text: Ensure CLIENT_URL includes protocol (http:// or https://)

docs.title: Database Connection Failed
docs.text: Check database credentials and network connection

docs.title: Port Conflict
docs.text: Change PORT environment variable and update frontend REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL

docs.title: FAQ Overview
docs.text: 

docs.title: Q: How to install RushChat?
docs.text: A: Please check the Installation Guide for detailed installation steps.

docs.title: Q: What to do if database connection fails?
docs.text: A: Check the following: - Ensure MySQL is running - Check database credentials in .env file - Verify database exists: mysql -u root -p -e "SHOW DATABASES;" - Check database user permissions

docs.title: Q: What to do if port is already in use?
docs.text: A: - Change PORT in .env file - Update REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL in client - Or stop the process using the port

docs.title: Q: How to resolve CORS errors?
docs.text: A: - Check backend CLIENT_URL environment variable - Ensure frontend address includes protocol (http:// or https://) - Ensure production environment uses HTTPS

docs.title: Q: How to register an account?
docs.text: A: 1. Click the "Register" button 2. Fill in username (3-20 characters), password (at least 6 characters), email (optional) 3. Click "Register"

docs.title: Q: How to create a channel?
docs.text:
A: 1. Click the "+" button in the left channel list 2. Enter channel name 3. Select "Public Channel" or "Private Channel" 4. If private channel, set password 5. Click "Create"

Note: - Regular users need 100,000 points, creation costs 50,000 points - Rush executives create for free, no points consumed

docs.title: Q: How to upload stickers?
docs.text:
A: 1. Click the emoji icon on the right side of the input box 2. Select "My Stickers" tab 3. Click "Upload Sticker" 4. Select GIF file (max 5MB)

Limits: - Regular users: up to 10 - Admins and channel owners: up to 100

docs.title: Q: How to invite friends?
docs.text:
A: 1. Click the user avatar in the top right corner 2. Select "Invite" 3. Copy invitation link or generate QR code 4. Share with friends

Rewards: - Successfully inviting a registered user, inviter gets 10,000 points and 5 channel contribution points

docs.title: Q: What is guest mode?
docs.text: A: Guest mode allows users to enter the chat room without registration, but can only view, cannot speak or upload images.

docs.title: Q: What is reserved word protection?
docs.text: A: The following usernames must use password login, cannot be used as guest: - admin, root, administrator, system, moderator, mod, superadmin, super, owner, manager

docs.title: Q: How to become an administrator?
docs.text: A: Administrators are appointed by senior administrators, cannot apply on their own.

docs.title: Q: How to get points?
docs.text: A: - Registration reward - Build incentive (can claim 1,000 points daily) - Invitation reward (successfully inviting a registered user gets 10,000 points) - Channel contribution (users registered through invitation link, inviter gets 5 channel contribution points)

docs.title: Q: How is honor level calculated?
docs.text: A: Honor level is automatically calculated based on total points, scoring mechanism includes: - Online time: Every 60 minutes online = 1 point - Invitations: Every successful invitation = 10 points - Message count: Every 100 messages sent = 1 point - Message likes: Each like = 2 points - Contract recommendations: Each contract recommended = 5 points - Recommendation score: Average voting score × 10

docs.title: Q: What to do if WebSocket connection fails?
docs.text: A: - Check if frontend REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL is correct - Ensure using HTTPS address (https://) - WebSocket will automatically convert to wss:// - Check if backend service is running normally

docs.title: Q: What to do if file upload fails?
docs.text: A: - Railway uses temporary file system, will be lost after restart - Configure Railway Volume for persistent storage - Or use external storage service (S3, Cloudinary, etc.)

docs.title: Q: How to view logs?
docs.text: A: - Backend logs: Check terminal output or log files - Frontend logs: Open browser developer tools (F12)

docs.title: Q: How to deploy to production environment?
docs.text: A: Please check the Deployment Guide

docs.title: Q: What to note for Railway deployment?
docs.text: A: - Configure environment variables - Set up MySQL database - Configure Railway Volume for persistent storage - Set health check endpoint

docs.title: Q: What to note for Vercel deployment?
docs.text: A: - Configure Root Directory: client - Configure environment variables - Ensure build command is correct

docs.title: Q: How to report bugs?
docs.text: A: Please submit an Issue in the GitHub repository, including: - Problem description - Reproduction steps - Expected behavior - Actual behavior - Environment information

docs.title: Q: How to contribute code?
docs.text: A: Please check the Contributing Guide

docs.title: Q: How to get help?
docs.text:
A: - Check Full Documentation - Check Troubleshooting - Submit GitHub Issue

Need more help? Please check Full Documentation or submit an Issue.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: This guide will help you get RushChat up and running in 5 minutes.

docs.title: Getting Started Overview
docs.text: 

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Node.js ≥ 18
  • Rust ≥ 1.70
  • MySQL ≥ 5.7 or MariaDB ≥ 10.3
  • Git

docs.title: 1. Clone Project
docs.text:
git clone <repository-url>
cd RushChat

docs.title: 2. Install Dependencies
docs.text:
# Install root directory dependencies
npm install

# Install client dependencies
cd client && npm install && cd ..

docs.title: Create Database
docs.text:
mysql -u root -p < database/schema.sql

Or execute manually:

mysql -u root -p
source database/schema.sql

docs.title: Configure Database Connection
docs.text:
Create a .env file in the project root directory:

DB_HOST=localhost
DB_PORT=3306
DB_USER=root
DB_PASSWORD=your_password
DB_NAME=rushchat

PORT=5001
NODE_ENV=development
CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:3000
REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL=http://localhost:5001

💡 Tip: You can copy docs/ENVIRONMENT_TEMPLATE.md as a template

docs.title: Start Backend (Rust)
docs.text:
cd server-rust
cargo run

The backend server will run at: http://localhost:5001

docs.title: Start Frontend (React)
docs.text:
Open a new terminal window:

cd client
npm start

The React development server will run at: http://localhost:3000

docs.title: 5. Access Application
docs.text: Open your browser and visit: http://localhost:3000

docs.title: Check Backend
docs.text: Visit http://localhost:5001/api/health (if health check endpoint is configured)

docs.title: Check Frontend
docs.text:
• Page loads normally
  • Chat interface is visible
  • Can enter as guest

curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh

brew services start mysql

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: Common problems and solutions.

docs.title: Troubleshooting Overview
docs.text: 

docs.title: Database Connection Failed
docs.text:
Problem: Unable to connect to database

Solution: 1. Check if MySQL is running: sudo systemctl status mysql 2. Check database credentials in .env file 3. Verify database exists: mysql -u root -p -e "SHOW DATABASES;" 4. Check database user permissions

docs.title: Database Migration Failed
docs.text:
Problem: Error when running migration script

Solution: 1. Check if database version is compatible 2. Check migration script syntax 3. View error logs 4. Manually execute SQL statements

docs.title: WebSocket Connection Failed
docs.text:
Problem: Unable to establish WebSocket connection

Solution: 1. Check if backend service is running 2. Check REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL configuration 3. Check firewall rules 4. Check CORS configuration

docs.title: CORS Error
docs.text:
Problem: Browser console shows CORS error

Solution: 1. Check backend CLIENT_URL environment variable 2. Ensure frontend address includes protocol (https://) 3. Check if domain matches 4. Check Nginx configuration (if using)

docs.title: Rust Compilation Error
docs.text:
Problem: cargo build fails

Solution: 1. Check Rust version: rustc --version 2. Update Rust: rustup update 3. Clean build cache: cargo clean 4. Check if dependencies are correct

docs.title: Frontend Build Error
docs.text:
Problem: npm run build fails

Solution: 1. Check Node.js version: node --version 2. Delete node_modules and reinstall 3. Check dependency version conflicts 4. View build logs

docs.title: Port Already in Use
docs.text:
Problem: Service startup failed, port is occupied

Solution: 1. Find process using the port: lsof -i :5001 2. Stop the process using the port 3. Or change PORT in .env

docs.title: File Upload Failed
docs.text:
Problem: Unable to upload files

Solution: 1. Check file size limit 2. Check directory permissions 3. Check disk space 4. Railway requires Volume configuration

docs.title: Wallet Connection Failed
docs.text:
Problem: Unable to connect wallet

Solution: 1. Check if wallet extension is installed 2. Check if wallet is unlocked 3. Check network configuration 4. View browser console errors

docs.title: Transaction Failed
docs.text:
Problem: On-chain transaction failed

Solution: 1. Check wallet balance 2. Check Gas fees 3. Check network connection 4. View transaction details

docs.title: Slow Response
docs.text:
Problem: Application responds slowly

Solution: 1. Check database connection pool configuration 2. Check network latency 3. Check server resources 4. Optimize database queries

docs.title: High Memory Usage
docs.text:
Problem: Server memory usage is high

Solution: 1. Check connection count 2. Check for memory leaks 3. Optimize code 4. Increase server memory

docs.text:
If the problem is still not resolved:

  1. Check FAQ
  2. Check GitHub Issues
  3. Submit a new Issue
  4. Contact maintainers

docs.title: Admin System
docs.text: RushChat uses a three-level administrator system, with different levels having different management permissions.

docs.title: Admin System Overview
docs.text: 

docs.title: A-level: Super Admin
docs.text:
Highest level administrator with all management permissions.

Permissions: - ✅ Kick users - ✅ Mute users - ✅ Appoint B-level and C-level admins - ✅ View operation logs - ✅ Operate all levels of users (including other admins) - ✅ All channel management permissions

docs.title: B-level: Rush Executive
docs.text:
Senior administrator with most management permissions.

Permissions: - ✅ Kick users - ✅ Mute users - ✅ Appoint C-level admins - ✅ Free channel creation (no points consumed) - ✅ Free access to private channels (no password required) - ✅ Upload stickers (up to 100)

Restrictions: - ❌ Cannot appoint B-level admins - ❌ Cannot operate A-level admins

docs.title: C-level: Regular Admin
docs.text:
Basic administrator with fundamental management permissions.

Permissions: - ✅ Kick users - ✅ Mute users - ✅ Pin messages - ✅ Upload stickers (up to 100)

Restrictions: - ❌ Cannot appoint other admins - ❌ Cannot operate other admins

docs.title: A-level Appoints B-level or C-level
docs.text:
1. Open admin panel
  2. Find target user
  3. Click "Appoint Admin"
  4. Select admin level (B-level or C-level)
  5. Confirm operation

docs.title: Operation Steps
docs.text:
1. Open admin panel
  2. Find target user
  3. Click "Kick" button
  4. Confirm operation

docs.title: Effects
docs.text:
• User immediately disconnected
  • Same IP address cannot enter for 60 minutes
  • Operation recorded in logs

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Can only kick regular users and lower-level admins
  • A-level admins can kick all users
  • B-level admins cannot kick A-level admins
  • C-level admins cannot kick other admins

docs.title: Operation Steps
docs.text:
1. Open admin panel
  2. Find target user
  3. Click "Mute" button
  4. Confirm operation

docs.title: Effects
docs.text:
• User cannot speak for 15 minutes
  • Can send messages but they won't be displayed
  • Operation recorded in logs

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Mute duration is fixed at 15 minutes
  • Can repeat mute to extend mute duration
  • Muting does not affect user viewing messages

docs.title: Operation Steps
docs.text:
1. Open admin panel
  2. Find target user
  3. Click "Appoint Admin" button
  4. Select admin level
  5. Confirm operation

docs.title: Permission Requirements
docs.text:
• A-level Admin: Can appoint B-level and C-level
  • B-level Admin: Can only appoint C-level
  • C-level Admin: Cannot appoint other admins

docs.title: Revoke Appointment
docs.text:
• Only A-level admins can revoke other admins' appointments
  • After revocation, user is restored to regular user

docs.title: Operation Steps
docs.text:
1. Find message to pin
  2. Click message menu
  3. Select "Pin"
  4. Confirm operation

docs.title: Effects
docs.text:
• Message displayed at channel top
  • All users can see it
  • Can unpin

docs.title: Permissions
docs.text:
• All admins can pin messages
  • Channel owners can also pin messages

docs.title: Permissions
docs.text: Detailed administrator permission comparison and explanation.

docs.title: Permission System Overview
docs.text: 

docs.title: Permission Comparison Table
docs.text: Feature A-level (Super Admin) B-level (Rush Executive) C-level (Regular Admin) Regular User Kick User ✅ ✅ ✅ ❌ Mute User ✅ ✅ ✅ ❌ Appoint B-level Admin ✅ ❌ ❌ ❌ Appoint C-level Admin ✅ ✅ ❌ ❌ View Operation Logs ✅ ❌ ❌ ❌ Operate Other Admins ✅ ❌ ❌ ❌ Free Channel Creation ✅ ✅ ❌ ❌ Free Access to Private Channels ✅ ✅ ❌ ❌ Pin Message ✅ ✅ ✅ ❌ Upload Stickers (100) ✅ ✅ ✅ ❌ (10)

docs.title: Kick User
docs.text:
• A-level: Can kick all users, including other admins
  • B-level: Can kick regular users and C-level admins
  • C-level: Can only kick regular users

docs.title: Mute User
docs.text:
• All admins can mute users
  • Mute duration is fixed at 15 minutes
  • Can repeat mute to extend mute duration

docs.title: Appoint B-level Admin
docs.text:
• Only A-level admins can appoint B-level admins
  • Need to be cautious, ensure appointee is trustworthy

docs.title: Appoint C-level Admin
docs.text:
• Both A-level and B-level admins can appoint C-level admins
  • No limit on number of C-level admins

docs.title: Free Channel Creation
docs.text:
• A-level and B-level admins can create channels for free
  • No points consumed
  • Can create public and private channels

docs.title: Free Access to Private Channels
docs.text:
• A-level and B-level admins can freely access private channels
  • No password required
  • Convenient for management and supervision

docs.title: Pin Message
docs.text:
• All admins can pin messages
  • Channel owners can also pin messages
  • Used to highlight important information

docs.title: View Operation Logs
docs.text:
• Only A-level admins can view complete operation logs
  • Used for auditing and tracking
  • Ensures system security

docs.title: Permission Inheritance
docs.text:
Admin permissions are inherited:

  • A-level has all permissions
  • B-level has all C-level permissions plus additional permissions
  • C-level has basic management permissions

docs.title: Cannot Operate Superiors
docs.text:
• B-level cannot operate A-level
  • C-level cannot operate A-level and B-level

docs.title: Cannot Appoint Peers or Superiors
docs.text:
• B-level cannot appoint B-level
  • C-level cannot appoint any admins

docs.title: BSC 频道创建合约更新说明
问题分析
docs.text:
1. BNB 支付失败原因：前端代码只是简单转账，没有调用合约
  2. 功能缺失：EVM 合约缺少邀请者返佣功能（Solana 合约已有）

docs.title: 新增功能：
docs.text:
• ✅ 添加邀请者返佣功能（与 Solana 合约逻辑一致）
  • ✅ 新增 createChannelWithReferrer 函数
  • ✅ 保留 createChannel 函数（无邀请者版本）

docs.title: 分配逻辑（与 Solana 一致）：
docs.text:
• 有邀请者：
  • 30% 给邀请者
  • 70% 给平台 → 平台再分配：30%销毁，50%开发者，20%建设者
  • 无邀请者：
  • 100% 给平台 → 平台分配：30%销毁，50%开发者，20%建设者

docs.title: 数据结构更新：
docs.text:
struct ChannelCreationData {
    address creator;
    address referrer;          // 新增：邀请者地址
    uint256 totalAmount;
    uint256 referrerAmount;   // 新增：邀请者金额
    uint256 burnAmount;
    uint256 developerAmount;
    uint256 builderAmount;
    bool exists;
}

docs.title: 事件更新：
docs.text:
event ChannelCreated(
    string indexed channelId,
    address indexed creator,
    address indexed referrer,      // 新增
    uint256 totalAmount,
    uint256 referrerAmount,        // 新增
    uint256 burnAmount,
    uint256 developerAmount,
    uint256 builderAmount
);

docs.title: 新增功能：
docs.text:
• ✅ BNB 支付时调用合约（而不是简单转账）
  • ✅ 支持邀请者返佣参数
  • ✅ 从后端 API 获取合约地址

docs.title: 实现逻辑：
docs.text:
1. 检查是否是频道创建支付（isChannelCreation && currency === 'BNB'）
  2. 从后端 API 获取合约地址：/api/config/channel-creation-addresses?chainId=97
  3. 使用 viem 编码函数调用
  4. 调用 createChannelWithReferrer 函数

docs.title: 1. 部署合约到 BSC 测试网
docs.text:
cd contracts
npx hardhat compile
npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network bscTestnet

部署时需要提供以下参数： - _burnAddress: 黑洞地址（用于销毁） - _developerWallet: 开发者钱包地址 - _builderWallet: 建设者激励钱包地址 - _tokenContract: Token 合约地址（用于回购）

docs.title: 2. 配置环境变量
docs.text:
在 .env 文件中添加： 

# BSC 频道创建合约地址
BSC_CHANNEL_CREATION_CONTRACT_ADDRESS=0x...  # 部署后的合约地址

# BSC 分配地址
BSC_BURN_ADDRESS=0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD
BSC_DEVELOPER_ADDRESS=0x...  # 开发者地址
BSC_BUILDER_ADDRESS=0x...    # 建设者地址

docs.title: 3. 更新后端 API
docs.text:
在 server-rust/src/handlers/config.rs 中添加 BSC 合约地址返回逻辑：

// 在 get_channel_creation_addresses 函数中添加 BSC 支持
if chain_id == 97 || chain_id == 56 {
    let contract_address = std::env::var("BSC_CHANNEL_CREATION_CONTRACT_ADDRESS")
        .or_else(|_| std::env::var("BSC_RECIPIENT_ADDRESS"));

    let burn_address = std::env::var("BSC_BURN_ADDRESS")
        .unwrap_or_else(|_| "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD".to_string());

    let developer_address = std::env::var("BSC_DEVELOPER_ADDRESS")
        .unwrap_or_else(|_| "".to_string());

    let builder_address = std::env::var("BSC_BUILDER_ADDRESS")
        .unwrap_or_else(|_| "".to_string());

    // 返回 JSON 响应
}

docs.title: 4. 更新前端默认地址
docs.text:
在 CryptoPaymentModal.js 中更新默认合约地址： 

const DEFAULT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS = '0x...'; // 部署后的合约地址
const DEFAULT_DEVELOPER_ADDRESS = '0x...'; // 开发者地址
const DEFAULT_BUILDER_ADDRESS = '0x...';   // 建设者地址

docs.title: 测试步骤
docs.text:
1. 部署合约到 BSC 测试网
  2. 配置环境变量（合约地址和分配地址）
  3. 更新后端 API以返回 BSC 合约地址
  4. 测试频道创建：
  5. 无邀请者：验证分配是否正确（30%销毁，50%开发者，20%建设者）
  6. 有邀请者：验证分配是否正确（30%邀请者，21%销毁，35%开发者，14%建设者）

docs.title: 注意事项
docs.text:
1. Gas 限制：合约调用需要更多 gas，已设置为 100000
  2. 金额精度：BNB 使用 18 位小数（1 BNB = 1e18 wei）
  3. 合约地址验证：确保合约地址格式正确（0x + 40 个十六进制字符）
  4. 邀请者地址：如果没有邀请者，传递 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000

docs.title: 交易失败分析
docs.text:
根据提供的交易链接：https://testnet.bscscan.com/tx/0x0f33cbd1b4e5bc0f86cfbf2d278a5764ae2d695e08450429d6deda1a02d91647

可能的原因： 1. 只是简单转账，没有调用合约 2. 合约未部署或地址错误 3. Gas 不足 4. 合约逻辑错误

更新后的代码将： - ✅ 调用合约而不是简单转账 - ✅ 自动分配资金（邀请者、销毁、开发者、建设者） - ✅ 与 Solana 合约逻辑一致

  • 可选参数：可以设置为零地址 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000

当实现 Token 回购销毁功能时，此地址将用于：

  2. 销毁 Token：将购买的 Token 发送到黑洞地址进行销毁
  3. 通缩机制：通过回购销毁减少 Token 总供应量

docs.text:
部署脚本已更新，会自动将 BSC_TOKEN_CONTRACT 写入 .env 文件：

docs.title: BSC 频道创建合约部署指南
概述
docs.text: 本指南说明如何部署 BSC 频道创建合约，并自动更新环境变量配置。

docs.title: 前置要求
docs.text:
1. Node.js 和 npm 已安装
  2. Hardhat 已配置
  3. BSC 测试网账户，有足够的 BNB 支付 Gas
  4. 私钥已配置在环境变量中

docs.title: 配置环境变量
docs.text:
在项目根目录的 .env 文件中配置以下变量：

# 部署账户私钥（用于支付 Gas）
PRIVATE_KEY=your_private_key_here

# BSC RPC URL（测试网）
BSC_TESTNET_RPC_URL=https://data-seed-prebsc-1-s1.binance.org:8545

# BSC 分配地址（部署前必须配置）
BSC_BURN_ADDRESS=0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD  # 黑洞地址
BSC_DEVELOPER_ADDRESS=0x...  # 开发者钱包地址（必须配置）
BSC_BUILDER_ADDRESS=0x...    # 建设者激励钱包地址（必须配置）

# Token 合约地址（可选，用于回购）
BSC_TOKEN_CONTRACT=0x...      # Token 合约地址（如果不需要回购，可以设为零地址）

# BSCScan API Key（用于合约验证，可选）
BSCSCAN_API_KEY=your_bscscan_api_key

docs.title: 1. 编译合约
docs.text:
cd contracts
npm run compile

docs.title: 2. 部署到 BSC 测试网
docs.text: npm run deploy:channel-creation:bsc-testnet

docs.title: 3. 部署到 BSC 主网（生产环境）
docs.text: npm run deploy:channel-creation:bsc-mainnet

docs.title: 部署后自动更新
docs.text:
部署脚本会自动：

  1. ✅ 更新根目录 .env 文件，添加以下环境变量： 

    BSC_CHANNEL_CREATION_CONTRACT_ADDRESS=0x...
BSC_BURN_ADDRESS=0x...
BSC_DEVELOPER_ADDRESS=0x...
BSC_BUILDER_ADDRESS=0x...

  2. ✅ 添加链特定配置（用于多链支持）： 

    BSC_CHANNEL_CREATION_CONTRACT_ADDRESS_97=0x...  # 测试网
BSC_CHANNEL_CREATION_CONTRACT_ADDRESS_56=0x...   # 主网

  3. ✅ 验证合约代码（如果配置了 BSCScan API Key）

docs.title: 后端（Rust）
docs.text:
后端会自动从根目录 .env 文件读取环境变量：

// server-rust/src/handlers/config.rs
let contract_address = std::env::var("BSC_CHANNEL_CREATION_CONTRACT_ADDRESS")
    .or_else(|_| std::env::var("BSC_RECIPIENT_ADDRESS"));

docs.title: 前端（React）
docs.text:
前端通过 craco.config.js 从根目录 .env 读取并注入到代码中：

// client/craco.config.js
const bscChannelCreationContract = process.env.BSC_CHANNEL_CREATION_CONTRACT_ADDRESS || '';

前端代码中可以直接使用： 

// client/src/components/CryptoPaymentModal.js
const contractAddress = process.env.BSC_CHANNEL_CREATION_CONTRACT_ADDRESS || '';

docs.title: 验证部署
docs.text:
部署成功后，检查：

  1. 合约地址：部署脚本会输出合约地址
  2. 环境变量：检查根目录 .env 文件是否已更新
  3. API 端点：访问 /api/config/channel-creation-addresses?chainId=97 应该返回合约地址
  4. 前端调用：尝试创建频道，应该能成功调用合约

docs.title: 问题：部署失败，提示 "BSC_DEVELOPER_ADDRESS 未配置"
docs.text:
解决方案：在根目录 .env 文件中添加： 

BSC_DEVELOPER_ADDRESS=0x...
BSC_BUILDER_ADDRESS=0x...

docs.title: 问题：环境变量未自动更新
docs.text: 解决方案： 1. 检查部署脚本是否有写入权限 2. 手动将合约地址添加到 .env 文件 3. 重启开发服务器

docs.title: 问题：前端无法读取环境变量
docs.text: 解决方案： 1. 确保环境变量在根目录 .env 文件中 2. 重启前端开发服务器（环境变量在构建时注入） 3. 检查 craco.config.js 是否正确配置

docs.title: 注意事项
docs.text:
1. 私钥安全：永远不要将私钥提交到版本控制系统
  2. Gas 费用：确保部署账户有足够的 BNB/ETH
  3. 合约验证：部署后建议验证合约代码，方便在区块浏览器查看
  4. 多链支持：脚本会自动添加链特定配置，支持多链部署

docs.title: 相关文件
docs.text:
• 部署脚本：contracts/scripts/deploy-channel-creation.js
  • 合约代码：contracts/contracts/ChannelCreation.sol
  • 前端配置：client/craco.config.js
  • 后端 API：server-rust/src/handlers/config.rs

docs.title: 1. 创建 .env 文件
docs.text:
在 contracts/ 目录下创建 .env 文件：

cd contracts
cp .env.example .env

docs.title: 2. 配置私钥
docs.text:
编辑 .env 文件，设置 PRIVATE_KEY：

# 私钥格式：必须以 0x 开头，64 个十六进制字符
PRIVATE_KEY=0x你的私钥

重要： - 私钥必须以 0x 开头 - 私钥长度必须是 66 个字符（包括 0x） - 示例：PRIVATE_KEY=0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef

docs.title: 方法 1: 使用 MetaMask
docs.text:
1. 打开 MetaMask
  2. 选择测试网账户
  3. 点击账户名称 → "账户详情"
  4. 点击"导出私钥"
  5. 输入密码后复制私钥

docs.title: 方法 2: 使用命令行生成
docs.text:
# 使用 Node.js 生成随机私钥（仅用于测试）
node -e "console.log('0x' + require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"

BSC 测试网 (BSC Testnet)

  2. 输入你的钱包地址
  3. 获取测试 BNB

  2. 输入你的钱包地址
  3. 获取测试 ETH

cd contracts
npm install

docs.title: 2. 配置环境变量
docs.text: 确保 .env 文件已正确配置（见上方步骤）

docs.title: 3. 编译合约
docs.text: npm run compile

docs.title: 5. 保存部署信息
docs.text:
部署成功后，会输出：

RedPacket deployed to: 0x...
Network: bscTestnet
Chain ID: 97

=== Deployment Info ===
{
  "network": "bscTestnet",
  "chainId": "97",
  "contractAddress": "0x...",
  "deployer": "0x...",
  "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
}

重要：保存这些信息！

docs.title: 6. 自动更新环境变量
docs.text:
✅ 部署脚本会自动更新 .env 文件！

部署成功后，脚本会自动： - 查找项目根目录或 server-rust 目录下的 .env 文件 - 如果 .env 文件不存在，会在项目根目录创建 - 自动更新或添加以下环境变量： - RED_PACKET_CONTRACT_ADDRESS（合约地址） - RED_PACKET_CONTRACT_CHAIN_ID（链 ID）

无需手动配置！ 部署完成后，环境变量已自动更新。

如果自动更新失败，可以手动添加到 .env 文件：

# server-rust/.env 或项目根目录 .env
RED_PACKET_CONTRACT_ADDRESS=0x...  # 从部署输出中复制
RED_PACKET_CONTRACT_CHAIN_ID=97     # BSC Testnet

docs.title: ⚠️ 私钥安全
docs.text:
1. 永远不要提交 .env 文件
  2. .env 已在 .gitignore 中

  3. 确保不会意外提交到 Git

  4. 使用测试钱包

  5. 测试网部署使用专门的测试钱包

  6. 不要使用主网钱包的私钥

  7. 主网部署

  8. 使用硬件钱包
  9. 或使用安全的密钥管理服务（如 AWS Secrets Manager）

  10. 考虑使用多签钱包

  11. 私钥格式检查 

    # 验证私钥格式
echo $PRIVATE_KEY | grep -E '^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$'

docs.title: ✅ 部署前检查清单
docs.text:
• [ ] .env 文件已创建
  • [ ] PRIVATE_KEY 已配置（格式正确）
  • [ ] 钱包有足够的测试币（用于支付 Gas）
  • [ ] RPC 端点已配置
  • [ ] 已编译合约（无错误）
  • [ ] 已保存部署信息（合约地址等）

docs.title: 问题 1: "Invalid private key"
docs.text:
原因： 私钥格式不正确

解决： - 确保私钥以 0x 开头 - 确保私钥长度为 66 个字符 - 检查是否有空格或换行符

docs.title: 问题 2: "insufficient funds for gas"
docs.text:
原因： 钱包余额不足

解决： - 从测试网水龙头获取测试币 - 检查钱包地址是否正确

docs.title: 问题 3: "nonce too low"
docs.text:
原因： 网络状态不同步

解决： - 等待几分钟后重试 - 检查 RPC 端点是否正常

docs.title: 问题 4: 合约验证失败
docs.text:
原因： Block Explorer API Key 未配置或无效

解决： - 验证是可选的，不影响合约使用 - 如需验证，配置正确的 API Key

docs.title: createRedPacket
docs.text:
Creates a new red packet on-chain.

function createRedPacket(
    string memory packetId,
    uint256 numRecipients,
    bool randomized,
    uint256 deadline
) external payable

Parameters: - packetId: Unique identifier for the red packet (string) - numRecipients: Number of recipients (uint256) - randomized: Whether to use random distribution (bool) - true: Random distribution (拼手气红包) - false: Equal distribution (普通红包) - deadline: Expiration timestamp (uint256)

Requirements: - msg.value > 0: Must send funds with the transaction - numRecipients > 0: Must have at least one recipient - deadline > block.timestamp: Deadline must be in the future - !redPackets[packetId].exists: Packet ID must be unique

Events: - Emits RedPacketCreated event with packet details

docs.title: claimRedPacket
docs.text:
Claims a red packet and receives the allocated amount.

function claimRedPacket(string memory packetId) external

Parameters: - packetId: Unique identifier for the red packet (string)

Requirements: - Packet must exist - Caller must not have claimed before - Packet must not be fully claimed - Packet must not be expired - Packet must have remaining amount

Distribution Logic:

Random Distribution: - Uses block timestamp, prevrandao, sender address, packet ID, and claim count for randomness - Random range: 0.1x to 1.9x of average amount - Last recipient receives all remaining amount - Ensures minimum 1 wei per claim - Prevents claims that would leave insufficient funds for remaining recipients

Equal Distribution: - Divides remaining amount equally among remaining recipients - Last recipient may receive slightly more due to rounding

Events: - Emits RedPacketClaimed event with claimer address, amount, and remaining count

docs.title: refundExpired
docs.text:
Refunds expired red packet to creator.

function refundExpired(string memory packetId) external

Parameters: - packetId: Unique identifier for the red packet (string)

Requirements: - Packet must exist - block.timestamp > deadline: Packet must be expired - remainingAmount > 0: Must have remaining amount

Behavior: - Transfers all remaining amount to creator - Sets remaining amount to 0

docs.title: withdrawUnclaimed
docs.text:
Allows creator to withdraw unclaimed amount after 5 minutes.

function withdrawUnclaimed(string memory packetId) external

Parameters: - packetId: Unique identifier for the red packet (string)

Requirements: - Packet must exist - msg.sender == creator: Only creator can withdraw - remainingAmount > 0: Must have remaining amount - Must be at least 5 minutes after creation (enforced by frontend)

docs.title: CreateRedPacket
docs.text:
Creates a new red packet using a PDA (Program Derived Address).

Accounts: - [writable, signer] Creator account (funds source) - [writable] Red packet PDA account (to be created) - [] System program - [] Rent sysvar

Instruction Data: 

CreateRedPacket {
    packet_id: String,        // Unique identifier (max 64 chars)
    num_recipients: u32,      // Number of recipients
    randomized: bool,         // Random distribution flag
    deadline: i64,           // Expiration timestamp
    amount: u64,             // Amount in lamports (excluding rent)
}

Behavior: - Creates PDA account to store red packet data - Transfers funds from creator to PDA - Initializes red packet data structure - PDA address is derived from: [program_id, "red_packet", packet_id]

docs.title: ClaimRedPacket
docs.text:
Claims a red packet and receives allocated amount.

Accounts: - [writable, signer] Claimer account - [writable] Red packet PDA account - [] Clock sysvar

Instruction Data: 

ClaimRedPacket {
    packet_id: String,        // Unique identifier
}

Requirements: - Packet must exist - Caller must not have claimed before - Packet must not be fully claimed - Packet must not be expired - Packet must have remaining amount

Distribution Logic:

Random Distribution: - Uses clock timestamp, claimer address, packet ID, and claim count for randomness - Random range: 0.1x to 1.9x of average amount - Last recipient receives all remaining amount - Ensures minimum 1 lamport per claim

Equal Distribution: - Divides remaining amount equally among remaining recipients

Behavior: - Transfers allocated amount to claimer - Updates red packet state - Adds claimer to claimers list

docs.title: RefundExpired
docs.text:
Refunds expired red packet to creator.

Accounts: - [signer] Creator account - [writable] Red packet PDA account - [] Clock sysvar

Instruction Data: 

RefundExpired {
    packet_id: String,        // Unique identifier
}

Requirements: - Packet must exist - clock.unix_timestamp > deadline: Packet must be expired - remaining_amount > 0: Must have remaining amount - msg.sender == creator: Only creator can refund

Behavior: - Transfers all remaining amount to creator - Sets remaining amount to 0

docs.title: RedPacketData
docs.text:
pub struct RedPacketData {
    pub creator: Pubkey,          // Creator's public key (32 bytes)
    pub total_amount: u64,        // Total amount in lamports (8 bytes)
    pub remaining_amount: u64,   // Remaining amount in lamports (8 bytes)
    pub num_recipients: u32,      // Total number of recipients (4 bytes)
    pub claimed_count: u32,      // Number of claims made (4 bytes)
    pub randomized: bool,          // Random distribution flag (1 byte)
    pub deadline: i64,            // Expiration timestamp (8 bytes)
    pub packet_id: String,         // Unique packet identifier (4 + len bytes)
    pub claimers: Vec<Pubkey>,     // List of claimer public keys (4 + 32*N bytes)
}

Account Size Calculation: 

pub fn calculate_size(packet_id_len: usize, max_claimers: usize) -> usize {
    32 +  // creator: Pubkey
    8 +   // total_amount: u64
    8 +   // remaining_amount: u64
    4 +   // num_recipients: u32
    4 +   // claimed_count: u32
    1 +   // randomized: bool
    8 +   // deadline: i64
    4 + packet_id_len +  // packet_id: String
    4 + (32 * max_claimers)  // claimers: Vec<Pubkey>
}

Constants: - MAX_PACKET_ID_LEN: 64 characters - MAX_CLAIMERS: 1000 claimers

}

docs.title: PDA Derivation
docs.text:
The red packet PDA is derived using:

let (pda, bump) = Pubkey::find_program_address(
    &[
        b"red_packet",
        packet_id.as_bytes(),
    ],
    program_id,
);

docs.title: Comparison: EVM vs Solana
docs.text: Feature EVM (Solidity) Solana (Rust) Language Solidity Rust Storage Contract storage (mappings) PDA accounts Gas/Transaction Fees Gas fees (ETH/BNB) Transaction fees (SOL) Randomness block.prevrandao + block.timestamp Clock timestamp + account data Account Model Address-based Account-based (PDA) Data Size Limits No explicit limit Account size must be calculated Refund Mechanism Direct transfer PDA to creator transfer Claim Tracking Nested mappings Vector in account data

docs.title: EVM Contract
docs.text:
1. Reentrancy Protection: Uses transfer() which limits gas, preventing reentrancy
  2. Randomness: Uses block.prevrandao (post-Paris upgrade) for better randomness
  3. Access Control: Owner-only functions for emergency situations
  4. Overflow Protection: Solidity 0.8.20 has built-in overflow checks

docs.title: Solana Program
docs.text:
1. Account Validation: All accounts are validated before use
  2. PDA Security: Uses PDAs to ensure account ownership
  3. Rent Exemption: Accounts must maintain rent-exempt balance
  4. Instruction Validation: All instruction data is validated
  5. Error Handling: Comprehensive error types for debugging

docs.title: Integration with X402 Protocol
docs.text:
Both contracts integrate with the X402 payment protocol:

  1. Payment Verification: Backend verifies on-chain transactions
  2. Payment Requirements: Server returns payment requirements via X402 headers
  3. On-chain Settlement: Funds are stored in contracts, not platform wallets
  4. Decentralized: No platform custody of funds

docs.title: 为什么需要验证合约？
docs.text: 验证合约后，BscScan 浏览器会： - ✅ 显示源代码（而不是字节码） - ✅ 显示函数名（如 claimRedPacket）而不是函数选择器（如 0x1a3c57e6） - ✅ 提供交互式合约调用界面 - ✅ 显示完整的 ABI - ✅ 提高合约透明度和可信度

docs.title: 1. 获取 BscScan API Key
docs.text:
1. 访问 BscScan（主网）或 BscScan Testnet（测试网）
  2. 注册/登录账户
  3. 进入 API Keys 页面
  4. 点击 "Add" 创建新的 API Key
  5. 复制 API Key

docs.title: 2. 配置 API Key
docs.text:
在 contracts/.env 文件中添加：

BSCSCAN_API_KEY=你的API密钥

docs.title: 方法 A: 使用验证脚本（推荐）
docs.text:
# 设置合约地址
export RED_PACKET_CONTRACT_ADDRESS=0x你的合约地址

# BSC 测试网
npm run verify:bsc-testnet

# BSC 主网
npm run verify:bsc-mainnet

docs.title: 方法 B: 使用 Hardhat 命令
docs.text:
# BSC 测试网
npx hardhat verify --network bscTestnet <合约地址>

# BSC 主网
npx hardhat verify --network bscMainnet <合约地址>

docs.title: 方法 C: 部署时自动验证
docs.text: 部署脚本已包含自动验证功能。如果部署时验证失败，可以稍后手动验证。

docs.title: 4. 验证成功
docs.text:
验证成功后，你会看到：

✅ 合约验证成功！
🔗 可在 BscScan 查看: https://testnet.bscscan.com/address/0x...

docs.title: Q: 验证失败，提示 "Already Verified"
docs.text: A: 合约已经验证过了，无需重复验证。

docs.title: Q: 验证失败，提示 "Contract source code already verified"
docs.text: A: 合约已经验证过了，这是正常提示。

docs.title: Q: 验证失败，提示 "Fail - Unable to verify"
docs.text:
A: 可能的原因： 1. API Key 未配置或无效 2. 合约地址错误 3. 网络问题 4. 合约部署后等待时间不够（需要至少 5 个区块确认）

解决方案： - 检查 .env 文件中的 BSCSCAN_API_KEY - 确认合约地址正确 - 等待几分钟后重试 - 检查网络连接

docs.title: Q: 如何手动验证？
docs.text:
如果自动验证失败，可以：

  1. 访问 BscScan 合约地址页面
  2. 点击 "Contract" 标签
  3. 点击 "Verify and Publish"
  4. 选择 "Solidity (Single file)" 或 "Solidity (Standard JSON Input)"
  5. 填写合约信息并上传源代码

docs.title: Q: 验证后多久生效？
docs.text: 通常验证后立即生效，最多等待 1-2 分钟。

docs.title: 验证前
docs.text:
• 显示：0x1a3c57e6（函数选择器）
  • 无法查看源代码
  • 无法交互式调用

docs.title: 验证后
docs.text:
• 显示：claimRedPacket(string)（函数名和参数）
  • 可以查看完整源代码
  • 可以交互式调用合约函数
  • 显示完整的 ABI

docs.title: 注意事项
docs.text:
1. API Key 安全
  2. 不要将 API Key 提交到代码仓库

  3. API Key 仅用于验证，不会影响合约安全性

  4. 验证时机

  5. 建议部署后立即验证

  6. 如果部署时验证失败，可以稍后手动验证

  7. 多链部署

  8. 每个链需要单独验证
  9. 使用对应的 API Key（BscScan 主网和测试网使用同一个 API Key）

docs.title: Nginx Configuration Overview
docs.text: 

docs.title: HTTP to HTTPS Redirect
docs.text:
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name your-domain.com;
    return 301 https://$server_name$request_uri;
}

docs.title: HTTPS Configuration
docs.text:
server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name your-domain.com;

    ssl_certificate /path/to/cert.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /path/to/key.pem;

    # SSL Configuration
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
    ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;

    # Proxy to Backend
    location /api {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:5001;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    # WebSocket Support
    location /ws {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:5001;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;

        # WebSocket Timeout Settings
        proxy_read_timeout 86400;
    }

    # Static Files (Frontend)
    location / {
        root /path/to/client/build;
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }

    # File Upload
    client_max_body_size 10M;
}

docs.text: RushChat's honor level system automatically calculates based on user activity and contributions.

docs.title: Honor Level System Overview
docs.text: 

docs.title: Level System
docs.text:
Honor levels are divided into 11 levels (0-10):

Level Points Range Level Name Level 0 0-99 points Novice Level 1 100-199 points Beginner Level 2 200-299 points Junior Level 3 300-499 points Intermediate Level 4 500-799 points Advanced Level 5 800-1299 points Senior Level 6 1300-1999 points Expert Level 7 2000-2999 points Master Level 8 3000-4999 points Legend Level 9 5000-7999 points Myth Level 10 8000+ points Legendary

docs.title: Scoring Mechanism
docs.text: Honor points are calculated based on the following factors:

docs.title: 1. Online Time
docs.text:
• Every 60 minutes online = 1 point
  • Automatically calculated, real-time update
  • Cumulative calculation

docs.title: 2. Invitations
docs.text:
• Every successful invitation = 10 points
  • Calculated immediately when user registers

docs.title: 3. Message Count
docs.text:
• Every 100 messages sent = 1 point
  • Cumulative calculation

docs.title: 4. Message Likes
docs.text:
• Each like = 2 points
  • Real-time calculation

docs.title: 5. Contract Recommendations
docs.text:
• Each contract recommended = 5 points
  • Calculated immediately when recommended

docs.title: 6. Recommendation Score
docs.text:
• Average voting score × 10
  • Calculated based on other users' votes

docs.text:

  • Display level name
  • Display points needed for next level

docs.title: Chat Interface
docs.text:
• Display level badge next to username (optional)
  • Different levels display different colors

  • Other benefits

docs.title: Voice Chat
docs.text: RushChat supports WebRTC voice calls in private channels.

docs.title: Feature Overview
docs.text: Voice chat allows users to make real-time voice calls in private channels, supporting multiple users online simultaneously, screen sharing, and more.

docs.title: Voice Chat Overview
docs.text: 

docs.title: Multi-user Voice Calls
docs.text:
• ✅ Supports multiple users online simultaneously (no fixed limit)
  • ✅ Real-time audio transmission
  • ✅ Low latency communication
  • ✅ WebRTC peer-to-peer communication

docs.title: Voice Controls
docs.text:
• ✅ Mute/Unmute
  • ✅ Volume control
  • ✅ Microphone switch
  • ✅ Owner can mute other members
  • ✅ Owner can kick members

docs.title: Screen Sharing
docs.text:
• ✅ Supports screen sharing
  • ✅ Real-time sharing status notification
  • ✅ Other members can see sharing status

docs.title: Permission Management
docs.text:
• ✅ Voice chat owner permissions (independent from channel owner)
  • ✅ Channel owner automatically takes over voice chat owner permissions
  • ✅ Owner can mute specific users
  • ✅ Owner can kick voice room members
  • ✅ Owner can invite other users to join voice chat
  • ✅ Permissions automatically transfer when owner leaves

docs.title: Invitation Feature
docs.text:
• ✅ Voice chat owner can invite other users
  • ✅ Invited users receive notifications
  • ✅ Supports accept/reject invitation

docs.title: Join Voice Room
docs.text:
1. Enter private channel
  2. Click "Join Voice" button
  3. Allow browser to access microphone
  4. Automatically join voice room
  5. System notifies other members in channel

docs.title: Leave Voice Room
docs.text:
1. Click "Leave Voice" button
  2. Or close channel page
  3. Automatically disconnect
  4. If user is voice chat owner, permissions automatically transfer to other participants

docs.title: Invite Other Users
docs.text:
1. As voice chat owner, click "Invite" button
  2. Select user to invite
  3. Invited user receives notification
  4. Invited user can choose to accept or reject

docs.title: Manage Voice Room
docs.text:
1. Mute Members: Owner can click mute button in member list
  2. Kick Members: Owner can kick inactive or violating members
  3. View Status: Can view current voice chat participant list

docs.title: WebRTC
docs.text:
Uses WebRTC technology for peer-to-peer communication:

  • ✅ Low latency audio transmission
  • ✅ High quality audio codec
  • ✅ Peer-to-peer direct connection (reduces server load)
  • ✅ Automatic NAT traversal

docs.title: Signaling Server
docs.text:
Uses WebSocket as signaling server:

  • ✅ Establish WebRTC connections
  • ✅ Exchange SDP (Session Description Protocol)
  • ✅ Exchange ICE candidates (NAT traversal)
  • ✅ Real-time state synchronization
  • ✅ Signaling data forwarding

docs.title: State Management
docs.text:
• ✅ Active voice chat records
  • ✅ Participant list management
  • ✅ Voice chat owner management
  • ✅ Automatic permission transfer
  • ✅ Status query interface

docs.title: Event System
docs.text:
Supports the following WebSocket events:

  • voice:join - Join voice chat
  • voice:leave - Leave voice chat
  • voice:signal - WebRTC signaling forwarding
  • voice:mute - Mute operation
  • voice:kick - Kick operation
  • voice:invite - Invite to join
  • voice:invite_reject - Reject invitation
  • voice:screen_share - Screen sharing status
  • voice:status - Query voice chat status

docs.title: X402 Protocol
docs.text: RushChat implements the Coinbase X402 protocol for payment and resource access control.

docs.title: X402 Protocol Overview
docs.text: 

docs.title: Protocol Overview
docs.text: X402 is an open protocol for web payments, allowing clients to access protected resources through cryptocurrency payments.

docs.title: Core Principles
docs.text:
According to the Coinbase X402 Protocol:

"Easy to use: x402 needs to be 10x better than existing ways to pay on the internet. This means abstracting as many details of crypto as possible away from the client and resource server, and into the facilitator."

Key point: Gas fees should be handled by the Facilitator, clients and resource servers don't need to consider Gas.

docs.title: 1. Client Requests Resource
docs.text: GET /api/resource

docs.title: 2. Server Returns 402
docs.text:
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
PAYMENT-REQUIRED: {
  "amount": "1000000000000000000",
  "currency": "ETH",
  "chainId": 1,
  "recipient": "0x..."
}

docs.title: 3. Client Provides Payment Proof
docs.text:
POST /api/resource
PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <signature>

docs.title: 4. Server Verifies Payment
docs.text:
• Verify transaction hash
  • Verify transaction amount
  • Verify transaction recipient
  • Verify on-chain status

docs.title: 5. Return Resource
docs.text:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
PAYMENT-RESPONSE: {
  "txHash": "0x...",
  "verified": true
}

docs.title: X402 Standards Compliant
docs.text:
• ✅ Uses HTTP 402 status code
  • ✅ Uses PAYMENT-REQUIRED header
  • ✅ Uses PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header
  • ✅ Uses PAYMENT-RESPONSE header
  • ✅ Data structure complies with standards
  • ✅ Real on-chain transactions
  • ✅ Transaction verification

docs.title: Optional Optimizations
docs.text:
• ⚠️ Facilitator (Gas abstraction): Currently not implemented, but this is optional
  • ⚠️ Batch payments: Planned
  • ⚠️ Payment subscriptions: Planned

docs.title: Current Implementation
docs.text:
• User pays Gas (when sending red packet)
  • Platform pays Gas (when claiming red packet)

docs.title: Ideal State (Using Facilitator)
docs.text:
• Facilitator pays Gas
  • User only needs to sign authorization
  • Better user experience

docs.text: 

docs.title: Database Overview
docs.text:
• Database Type: MySQL 5.7+ / MariaDB 10.3+
  • Character Set: utf8mb4 (supports emoji)
  • Storage Engine: InnoDB

docs.title: users - User Table
docs.text:
Stores user basic information and admin level.

Main Fields: - id - User ID (primary key) - username - Username (unique) - password_hash - Password hash - email - Email (optional) - avatar - Avatar (LONGTEXT, base64) - points - Points - admin_level - Admin level (A/B/C/null) - honor_level - Honor level (0-10) - evm_address - EVM wallet address - sol_address - Solana wallet address - created_at - Creation time

docs.title: messages - Message Table
docs.text:
Stores all chat messages (text, images, system messages).

Main Fields: - id - Message ID (primary key) - channel_id - Channel ID (foreign key) - username - Sender username - message - Message content (LONGTEXT) - message_type - Message type (text/image/system) - is_pinned - Whether pinned - created_at - Creation time

docs.title: channels - Channel Table
docs.text:
Stores channel information (public/private channels).

Main Fields: - id - Channel ID (primary key) - name - Channel name (unique) - is_private - Whether private channel - password_hash - Password hash (private channel) - owner_username - Owner username - logo - Channel logo - created_at - Creation time

docs.title: sessions - Online Session Table
docs.text:
Stores current online user session information.

Main Fields: - id - Session ID (primary key) - username - Username - socket_id - WebSocket ID - ip_address - IP address - channel_id - Current channel ID - last_active - Last active time

docs.title: banned_ips - IP Ban Table
docs.text:
Stores banned IP addresses.

Main Fields: - id - Record ID (primary key) - ip_address - IP address - banned_until - Ban expiration time - banned_by - Operator username - created_at - Creation time

docs.title: muted_users - Mute Table
docs.text:
Stores muted users.

Main Fields: - id - Record ID (primary key) - username - Username - muted_until - Mute expiration time - muted_by - Operator username - created_at - Creation time

docs.title: admin_logs - Admin Operation Log Table
docs.text:
Records all admin operations (kick, mute, appoint, etc.).

Main Fields: - id - Log ID (primary key) - admin_username - Admin username - action_type - Operation type (kick/mute/appoint) - target_username - Target username - details - Operation details (JSON) - created_at - Creation time

docs.title: Main Indexes
docs.text:
• users.username - Username unique index
  • messages.channel_id - Channel ID index
  • messages.created_at - Time index
  • sessions.username - Username index
  • banned_ips.ip_address - IP address index

docs.title: Clean Expired Data
docs.text:

CALL CleanExpiredData();

Or set up scheduled tasks for automatic cleanup.

docs.text:

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
1. Use utf8mb4 character set to support emoji and special characters
  2. Image data uses LONGTEXT type to store base64 encoding
  3. Regularly clean expired data to maintain database performance
  4. Recommend regular database backups
  5. Production environment recommend enabling SSL connections

docs.title: Honor Levels
docs.text:
Honor levels are divided into 11 levels (0-10), automatically calculated based on total points.

Level Points Range Level Name Level 0 0-99 points Novice Level 1 100-199 points Beginner Level 2 200-299 points Junior Level 3 300-499 points Intermediate Level 4 500-799 points Advanced Level 5 800-1299 points Senior Level 6 1300-1999 points Expert Level 7 2000-2999 points Master Level 8 3000-4999 points Legend Level 9 5000-7999 points Myth Level 10 8000+ points Legendary

docs.title: Scoring Mechanism
docs.text:
1. Online Time: Every 60 minutes online = 1 point
  2. Invitations: Every successful invitation = 10 points
  3. Message Count: Every 100 messages sent = 1 point
  4. Message Likes: Each like = 2 points
  5. Contract Recommendations: Each contract recommended = 5 points
  6. Recommendation Score: Average voting score × 10

docs.title: Rush.Moe 文档
docs.text: Solana 原生 Web3 实时聊天应用（兼容 EVM）

docs.title: 🚀 简介
docs.text:
Rush.Moe 是 Solana 原生 Web3 实时聊天应用（同时兼容 EVM）。第一时间发现 Alpha 即时交易是 Rush 的核心理念。

任何人可以在 Rush.Moe 构建自己的 Alpha 频道（可选择付费、私有，同时赚取交易手续费，支持 Solana & EVM NFT 验证进入私有频道）。语音聊天更能提升社区的即时交流效率。

邀请朋友加入 Rush.Moe，分享建立频道手续费 & 交易手续费（后续功能）。

docs.title: ✨ 核心特性
docs.text: 

docs.title: 🎯 核心理念
docs.text:
第一时间发现 Alpha 即时交易是 Rush 的核心理念。

Rush.Moe 让用户可以： - 构建和管理 Alpha 频道 - 通过频道创建和交易手续费赚取收益 - 通过 NFT 验证访问专属私有频道 - 通过语音聊天实现即时交流

  • ✅ NFT 验证 - Solana & EVM NFT 验证进入私有频道
  • ✅ 灵活的访问控制 - 密码保护和钱包验证

docs.text: 本文档记录 RushChat 的所有版本更新和功能变更。

docs.title: 更新日志概览
docs.text: 

docs.title: 新增功能
docs.text:
• ✅ 频道系统：支持创建和管理私密频道
  • ✅ 积分系统：用户积分管理和频道创建消耗
  • ✅ 钱包地址验证：EVM和SOL地址格式验证
  • ✅ Rush高管特权：免费创建频道、自由进出私密频道
  • ✅ 邀请系统：个性化邀请码、分享到X、二维码分享
  • ✅ 自定义表情包：用户可上传 GIF 表情包（10个/普通用户，100个/管理员和房主）
  • ✅ 表情包重复检测：使用 SHA256 哈希值防止重复上传
  • ✅ 语音聊天功能：WebRTC 语音通话，支持多人、屏幕共享、邀请、权限管理
  • ✅ 红包系统：EVM 和 Solana 链红包，支持普通红包和拼手气红包
  • ✅ X402 协议：实现 Coinbase X402 支付协议，支持链上支付验证
  • ✅ 钱包验证增强：支持 Metaplex Core NFT、DAS API、自动 RPC 回退

docs.title: 改进
docs.text:
• ✅ 优化用户列表去重逻辑
  • ✅ 改进会话管理，防止重复登录
  • ✅ 增强钱包地址验证的实时反馈
  • ✅ 修复头像上传问题：将avatar字段从VARCHAR(500)改为LONGTEXT，支持存储大容量base64图片数据
  • ✅ 图片压缩功能：上传头像时自动压缩图片，减少数据大小
  • ✅ 统一文件路径逻辑：确保上传和服务的文件路径一致
  • ✅ 优化路由顺序：确保特定路由优先于通用静态文件服务
  • ✅ Solana NFT 验证优化：使用 getAssetsByOwner (DAS API) 支持 Metaplex Core NFT
  • ✅ RPC 端点优化：默认使用 Helius RPC，自动检测 DAS API 支持并回退
  • ✅ 钱包连接优化：改进 Phantom、OKX 等钱包的连接和切换逻辑
  • ✅ 错误处理增强：全局错误处理，抑制浏览器扩展和钱包相关错误

docs.title: 用户系统
docs.text:
• ✅ 游客模式：无需注册，一键进入聊天室
  • ✅ 用户注册：支持用户名、密码、邮箱注册
  • ✅ 用户登录：密码验证登录
  • ✅ 会话保持：刷新页面自动恢复登录状态
  • ✅ 保留字保护：admin、root等用户名必须使用密码登录

docs.title: 聊天功能
docs.text:
• ✅ 实时消息：基于WebSocket的实时通信
  • ✅ 文本消息：支持纯文本消息发送
  • ✅ 图片分享：支持图片上传和分享（最大5MB）
  • ✅ 打字指示器：显示正在输入的用户
  • ✅ 在线用户列表：实时显示在线用户
  • ✅ 消息历史：自动加载历史消息

docs.title: 权限管理
docs.text:
• ✅ 三级管理员体系：A级（超级管理员）、B级（Rush高管）、C级（普通管理员）
  • ✅ IP封禁：管理员可封禁违规IP（60分钟）
  • ✅ 用户禁言：管理员可对用户进行临时禁言（15分钟）
  • ✅ 管理员任命：高级管理员可任命下级管理员

docs.title: 频道系统
docs.text:
• ✅ 公共频道：所有用户可访问的默认频道
  • ✅ 私密频道：需要密码才能加入的频道
  • ✅ 频道创建：
  • 普通用户：需要10万积分，创建消耗5万积分
  • Rush高管：免费创建，不消耗积分
  • ✅ 频道管理：房主可设置/修改频道密码
  • ✅ 频道切换：用户可以随时切换频道
  • ✅ 消息隔离：不同频道的消息相互隔离

docs.title: 用户资料
docs.text:
• ✅ 个人资料管理：可设置头像、邮箱、钱包地址
  • ✅ 头像上传：支持图片上传（最大5MB）
  • ✅ 钱包地址：
  • EVM地址（以太坊等）：格式验证
  • SOL地址（Solana）：格式验证
  • ✅ 密码修改：支持修改登录密码

docs.title: 界面设计
docs.text:
• ✅ Slack风格：现代化的聊天界面设计
  • ✅ 日夜间模式：支持主题切换
  • ✅ 响应式设计：适配桌面和移动设备
  • ✅ 多语言支持：中文/英文切换

docs.title: 前端
docs.text:
• React 18 + Hooks
  • Socket.io Client
  • CSS Variables（主题系统）
  • React Context（状态管理）
  • 实时验证和反馈

docs.title: 后端
docs.text:
• Rust + Axum
  • Tokio WebSocket（WebSocket）
  • MySQL（可选，支持内存模式）
  • bcrypt（密码加密）
  • 会话管理

docs.title: 表结构
docs.text:
• users: 用户表
  • messages: 消息表
  • channels: 频道表
  • sessions: 会话表
  • banned_ips: IP封禁表
  • muted_users: 禁言表
  • admin_logs: 管理员操作日志表

docs.title: 安全特性
docs.text:
• 密码加密存储（bcrypt）
  • 保留字保护
  • IP封禁机制
  • 用户禁言机制
  • 管理员操作日志

使用 Rust、React 和 MySQL 构建 ❤️

docs.title: 配置说明
docs.text: RushChat 的配置主要通过环境变量进行。

docs.title: 配置概览
docs.text: 

docs.title: 后端配置
docs.text: 在项目根目录创建 .env 文件（后端会优先加载项目根目录的 .env）。

docs.title: 基础服务
docs.text:
PORT=5001                    # 后端服务端口
NODE_ENV=development         # 环境模式：development | production
CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:3000  # 前端地址（用于 CORS）
MAIN_DOMAIN=localhost        # 主域名（生产环境设置为实际域名）

docs.title: 数据库
docs.text:
DB_HOST=localhost            # 数据库主机
DB_PORT=3306                 # 数据库端口
DB_USER=root                 # 数据库用户名
DB_PASSWORD=your_password    # 数据库密码
DB_NAME=rushchat             # 数据库名称

docs.title: Solana RPC（可选）
docs.text:
SOL_HTTP_RPC=https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com
SOL_RPC=https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com

docs.title: 红包合约（可选）
docs.text:
# EVM 链红包合约地址
RED_PACKET_CONTRACT_ADDRESS=

# Solana 红包程序 ProgramId（Base58，通常 32~44 长度）
# 重要：必须是"程序 ProgramId"，不是钱包地址
SOLANA_RED_PACKET_PROGRAM_ID=

docs.title: 前端配置
docs.text:
在 client/ 目录创建 .env 文件：

REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL=http://localhost:5001

docs.title: 数据库配置
docs.text: 数据库配置通过环境变量读取，无需额外配置文件。

docs.title: 频道规则配置
docs.text: 频道规则存储在数据库中，通过管理界面或 API 进行配置。

docs.title: Railway 部署
docs.text:
在 Railway 项目设置中配置环境变量：

DB_HOST=<railway_mysql_host>
DB_PORT=3306
DB_USER=<railway_mysql_user>
DB_PASSWORD=<railway_mysql_password>
DB_NAME=<railway_mysql_database>
PORT=5001
NODE_ENV=production
CLIENT_URL=https://your-app.vercel.app
MAIN_DOMAIN=your-domain.com

docs.title: Vercel 部署
docs.text:
在 Vercel 项目设置中配置环境变量：

REACT_APP_API_URL=https://your-backend.railway.app
REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL=https://your-backend.railway.app

docs.title: CORS 配置
docs.text: 后端通过 CLIENT_URL 环境变量控制 CORS 允许的来源。

docs.title: 数据库安全
docs.text:
• 使用强密码
  • 限制数据库访问 IP
  • 定期备份数据库

docs.title: 生产环境建议
docs.text:
• 使用 HTTPS
  • 设置强密码策略
  • 启用数据库 SSL 连接
  • 配置防火墙规则

docs.title: 环境变量优先级
docs.text:
后端环境变量加载顺序：

  1. 项目根目录 .env 文件
  2. 系统环境变量
  3. 默认值

docs.title: 检查环境变量
docs.text:
# 后端
cd server-rust
cargo run -- --check-env

# 前端
cd client
npm run check-env

docs.title: 测试数据库连接
docs.text: mysql -u $DB_USER -p$DB_PASSWORD -h $DB_HOST -P $DB_PORT $DB_NAME -e "SELECT 1;"

docs.title: CORS 错误
docs.text: 确保 CLIENT_URL 包含协议（http:// 或 https://）

docs.title: 数据库连接失败
docs.text: 检查数据库凭据和网络连接

docs.title: 端口冲突
docs.text: 更改 PORT 环境变量，并更新前端 REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL

docs.text:

docs.title: 常见问题概览
docs.text: 

docs.title: Q: 如何安装 RushChat？
docs.text: A: 请查看 安装指南 获取详细的安装步骤。

docs.title: Q: 数据库连接失败怎么办？
docs.text: A: 检查以下几点： - 确保 MySQL 正在运行 - 检查 .env 文件中的数据库凭据 - 验证数据库是否存在：mysql -u root -p -e "SHOW DATABASES;" - 检查数据库用户权限

docs.title: Q: 端口已被占用怎么办？
docs.text: A: - 在 .env 文件中更改 PORT - 更新客户端中的 REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL - 或者停止占用端口的进程

docs.title: Q: CORS 错误怎么解决？
docs.text: A: - 检查后端 CLIENT_URL 环境变量 - 确保前端地址包含协议（http:// 或 https://） - 确保生产环境使用 HTTPS

docs.title: Q: 如何注册账户？
docs.text: A: 1. 点击"注册"按钮 2. 填写用户名（3-20个字符）、密码（至少6个字符）、邮箱（可选） 3. 点击"注册"

docs.title: Q: 如何创建频道？
docs.text:
A: 1. 点击左侧频道列表的"+"按钮 2. 输入频道名称 3. 选择"公共频道"或"私密频道" 4. 如果是私密频道，设置密码 5. 点击"创建"

注意： - 普通用户需要 10 万积分，创建消耗 5 万积分 - Rush高管免费创建，不消耗积分

docs.title: Q: 如何上传表情包？
docs.text:
A: 1. 点击输入框右侧的表情图标 2. 选择"我的表情"标签 3. 点击"上传表情包" 4. 选择 GIF 文件（最大 5MB）

限制： - 普通用户最多 10 个 - 管理员和房主最多 100 个

docs.title: Q: 如何邀请朋友？
docs.text:
A: 1. 点击右上角用户头像 2. 选择"邀请" 3. 复制邀请链接或生成二维码 4. 分享给朋友

奖励： - 成功邀请注册用户，邀请人获得 10,000 积分和 5 频道贡献值

docs.title: Q: 什么是游客模式？
docs.text: A: 游客模式允许用户无需注册即可进入聊天室，但只能观看，不能发言或上传图片。

docs.title: Q: 什么是保留字保护？
docs.text: A: 以下用户名必须使用密码登录，不能以游客身份使用： - admin, root, administrator, system, moderator, mod, superadmin, super, owner, manager

docs.title: Q: 如何成为管理员？
docs.text: A: 管理员由高级管理员任命，不能自行申请。

docs.title: Q: 积分如何获取？
docs.text: A: - 注册奖励 - Build 激励（每日可领取 1000 积分） - 邀请奖励（成功邀请注册用户获得 10,000 积分） - 频道贡献（通过邀请链接注册的用户，邀请人获得 5 频道贡献值）

docs.title: Q: 荣誉等级如何计算？
docs.text: A: 荣誉等级根据总积分自动计算，评分机制包括： - 在线时长：每在线 60 分钟 = 1 分 - 邀请人数：每成功邀请 1 人 = 10 分 - 消息数量：每发送 100 条消息 = 1 分 - 消息点赞：每个点赞 = 2 分 - 合约推荐：每推荐 1 个合约 = 5 分 - 推荐评分：平均投票分数 × 10

docs.title: Q: WebSocket 连接失败怎么办？
docs.text: A: - 检查前端 REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL 是否正确 - 确保使用 HTTPS 地址（https://） - WebSocket 会自动转换为 wss:// - 检查后端服务是否正常运行

docs.title: Q: 文件上传失败怎么办？
docs.text: A: - Railway 使用临时文件系统，重启后会丢失 - 配置 Railway Volume 持久化存储 - 或使用外部存储服务（S3、Cloudinary 等）

docs.title: Q: 如何查看日志？
docs.text: A: - 后端日志：查看终端输出或日志文件 - 前端日志：打开浏览器开发者工具（F12）

docs.title: Q: 如何部署到生产环境？
docs.text: A: 请查看 部署指南

docs.title: Q: Railway 部署需要注意什么？
docs.text: A: - 配置环境变量 - 设置 MySQL 数据库 - 配置 Railway Volume 持久化存储 - 设置健康检查端点

docs.title: Q: Vercel 部署需要注意什么？
docs.text: A: - 配置 Root Directory: client - 配置环境变量 - 确保构建命令正确

docs.title: Q: 如何报告 Bug？
docs.text: A: 请在 GitHub 仓库提交 Issue，包含： - 问题描述 - 复现步骤 - 预期行为 - 实际行为 - 环境信息

docs.title: Q: 如何贡献代码？
docs.text: A: 请查看 贡献指南

docs.title: Q: 如何获取帮助？
docs.text:
A: - 查看 完整文档 - 查看 故障排除 - 提交 GitHub Issue

需要更多帮助？ 请查看 完整文档 或提交 Issue。

docs.text:

docs.text:
• Node.js ≥ 18
  • Rust ≥ 1.70
  • MySQL ≥ 5.7 或 MariaDB ≥ 10.3
  • Git

docs.title: 1. 克隆项目
docs.text:
git clone <repository-url>
cd RushChat

docs.title: 2. 安装依赖
docs.text:

npm install

# 安装客户端依赖
cd client && npm install && cd ..

mysql -u root -p < database/schema.sql

mysql -u root -p

docs.text:
在项目根目录创建 .env 文件：

DB_HOST=localhost
DB_PORT=3306

DB_PASSWORD=your_password

PORT=5001
NODE_ENV=development

docs.title: 安装指南
docs.text: 详细的安装和配置说明。

docs.title: 安装流程概览
docs.text: 

docs.title: 必需
docs.text:
• Node.js ≥ 18
  • Rust ≥ 1.70（使用 rustup 安装）
  • MySQL ≥ 5.7 或 MariaDB ≥ 10.3
  • Git

docs.title: 推荐
docs.text:
• npm 或 pnpm 包管理器
  • cargo（Rust 包管理器，随 Rust 安装）

docs.title: 1. 安装 Node.js
docs.text:
访问 Node.js 官网 下载并安装。

验证安装：

node --version  # 应显示 v18 或更高
npm --version

docs.title: 2. 安装 Rust
docs.text:
使用 rustup 安装：

curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh

验证安装：

rustc --version  # 应显示 1.70 或更高
cargo --version

docs.title: Windows
docs.text: 从 MySQL 官网 下载安装程序。

docs.title: 4. 克隆项目
docs.text:
git clone <repository-url>
cd RushChat

docs.title: 5. 安装项目依赖
docs.text:
# 安装根目录依赖
npm install

# 安装客户端依赖
cd client && npm install && cd ..

docs.title: 创建数据库
docs.text: mysql -u root -p < database/schema.sql

docs.title: 运行迁移（如果数据库已存在）
docs.text: mysql -u root -p rushchat < database/complete_schema_latest.sql

docs.title: 7. 配置环境变量
docs.text:
在项目根目录创建 .env 文件：

# 基础服务
PORT=5001
NODE_ENV=development
CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:3000

# 数据库
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_PORT=3306
DB_USER=root
DB_PASSWORD=your_password
DB_NAME=rushchat

# WebSocket
REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL=http://localhost:5001

# 红包合约（可选）
RED_PACKET_CONTRACT_ADDRESS=
SOLANA_RED_PACKET_PROGRAM_ID=

💡 提示：可以复制 docs/ENVIRONMENT_TEMPLATE.md 作为模板

docs.title: 检查数据库连接
docs.text:
mysql -u root -p -e "USE rushchat; SHOW TABLES;"

应该看到以下表： - users - messages - channels - sessions - 等等...

cargo check

docs.title: 检查前端依赖

npm list --depth=0

docs.title: 启动后端
docs.text:
cd server-rust
cargo run

docs.title: 启动前端
docs.text:
cd client
npm start

docs.title: 构建后端
docs.text:
cd server-rust
cargo build --release
./target/release/rushchat-server

npm run build

构建产物在 client/build/ 目录。

docs.title: 故障排除
docs.text: 常见问题和解决方案。

docs.title: 故障排除概览
docs.text: 

docs.title: 数据库连接失败
docs.text:
问题：无法连接到数据库

解决方案： 1. 检查 MySQL 是否运行：sudo systemctl status mysql 2. 检查 .env 文件中的数据库凭据 3. 验证数据库是否存在：mysql -u root -p -e "SHOW DATABASES;" 4. 检查数据库用户权限

docs.title: 数据库迁移失败
docs.text:
问题：运行迁移脚本时出错

解决方案： 1. 检查数据库版本是否兼容 2. 检查迁移脚本语法 3. 查看错误日志 4. 手动执行 SQL 语句

docs.title: WebSocket 连接失败
docs.text:
问题：无法建立 WebSocket 连接

解决方案： 1. 检查后端服务是否运行 2. 检查 REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL 配置 3. 检查防火墙规则 4. 检查 CORS 配置

docs.title: CORS 错误
docs.text:
问题：浏览器控制台显示 CORS 错误

解决方案： 1. 检查后端 CLIENT_URL 环境变量 2. 确保前端地址包含协议（https://） 3. 检查域名是否匹配 4. 检查 Nginx 配置（如果使用）

docs.title: Rust 编译错误
docs.text:
问题：cargo build 失败

解决方案： 1. 检查 Rust 版本：rustc --version 2. 更新 Rust：rustup update 3. 清理构建缓存：cargo clean 4. 检查依赖是否正确

docs.title: 前端构建错误
docs.text:
问题：npm run build 失败

解决方案： 1. 检查 Node.js 版本：node --version 2. 删除 node_modules 重新安装 3. 检查依赖版本冲突 4. 查看构建日志

docs.title: 端口已被占用
docs.text:
问题：服务启动失败，端口被占用

解决方案： 1. 查找占用端口的进程：lsof -i :5001 2. 停止占用端口的进程 3. 或更改 .env 中的 PORT

docs.title: 文件上传失败
docs.text:
问题：无法上传文件

解决方案： 1. 检查文件大小限制 2. 检查目录权限 3. 检查磁盘空间 4. Railway 需要配置 Volume

docs.title: 钱包连接失败
docs.text:
问题：无法连接钱包

解决方案： 1. 检查钱包扩展是否安装 2. 检查钱包是否解锁 3. 检查网络配置 4. 查看浏览器控制台错误

docs.title: 交易失败
docs.text:
问题：链上交易失败

docs.text: RushChat 采用三级管理员体系，不同级别拥有不同的管理权限。

docs.title: 管理员体系概览
docs.text: 

docs.title: A级：超级管理员
docs.text:
最高级别的管理员，拥有所有管理权限。

权限： - ✅ 踢出用户 - ✅ 禁言用户 - ✅ 任命 B级和 C级管理员 - ✅ 查看操作日志 - ✅ 操作所有级别的用户（包括其他管理员） - ✅ 所有频道管理权限

docs.title: B级：Rush高管
docs.text:
高级管理员，拥有大部分管理权限。

权限： - ✅ 踢出用户 - ✅ 禁言用户 - ✅ 任命 C级管理员 - ✅ 免费创建频道（不消耗积分） - ✅ 自由进出私密频道（无需密码） - ✅ 上传表情包（最多 100 个）

限制： - ❌ 不能任命 B级管理员 - ❌ 不能操作 A级管理员

docs.title: C级：普通管理员
docs.text:
基础管理员，拥有基本管理权限。

权限： - ✅ 踢出用户 - ✅ 禁言用户 - ✅ 置顶消息 - ✅ 上传表情包（最多 100 个）

限制： - ❌ 不能任命其他管理员 - ❌ 不能操作其他管理员

docs.title: createRedPacket
docs.text:
在链上创建新红包。

function createRedPacket(
    string memory packetId,
    uint256 numRecipients,
    bool randomized,
    uint256 deadline
) external payable

参数： - packetId: 红包唯一标识符（字符串） - numRecipients: 接收者数量（uint256） - randomized: 是否使用随机分配（布尔值） - true: 随机分配（拼手气红包） - false: 平均分配（普通红包） - deadline: 过期时间戳（uint256）

要求： - msg.value > 0: 必须随交易发送资金 - numRecipients > 0: 必须至少有一个接收者 - deadline > block.timestamp: 过期时间必须在未来 - !redPackets[packetId].exists: 红包 ID 必须唯一

事件： - 发出 RedPacketCreated 事件，包含红包详情

docs.title: claimRedPacket
docs.text:
领取红包并接收分配的金额。

function claimRedPacket(string memory packetId) external

参数： - packetId: 红包唯一标识符（字符串）

要求： - 红包必须存在 - 调用者之前不能领取过 - 红包不能已全部领取 - 红包不能已过期 - 红包必须有剩余金额

分配逻辑：

随机分配： - 使用区块时间戳、prevrandao、发送者地址、红包 ID 和领取次数生成随机数 - 随机范围：平均金额的 0.1 倍到 1.9 倍 - 最后一个领取者获得全部剩余金额 - 确保每次领取至少 1 wei - 防止领取导致剩余资金不足以支付其他领取者

平均分配： - 将剩余金额平均分配给剩余接收者 - 最后一个领取者可能因舍入获得稍多金额

事件： - 发出 RedPacketClaimed 事件，包含领取者地址、金额和剩余数量

docs.title: refundExpired
docs.text:
将过期的红包退还给创建者。

function refundExpired(string memory packetId) external

参数： - packetId: 红包唯一标识符（字符串）

要求： - 红包必须存在 - block.timestamp > deadline: 红包必须已过期 - remainingAmount > 0: 必须有剩余金额

行为： - 将所有剩余金额转给创建者 - 将剩余金额设置为 0

docs.title: withdrawUnclaimed
docs.text:
允许创建者在 5 分钟后提取未领取的金额。

function withdrawUnclaimed(string memory packetId) external

参数： - packetId: 红包唯一标识符（字符串）

要求： - 红包必须存在 - msg.sender == creator: 只有创建者可以提取 - remainingAmount > 0: 必须有剩余金额 - 必须在创建后至少 5 分钟（由前端强制执行）

docs.title: CreateRedPacket
docs.text:
使用 PDA（程序派生地址）创建新红包。

账户： - [writable, signer] 创建者账户（资金源） - [writable] 红包 PDA 账户（待创建） - [] 系统程序 - [] 租金系统变量

指令数据： 

CreateRedPacket {
    packet_id: String,        // 唯一标识符（最多 64 字符）
    num_recipients: u32,      // 接收者数量
    randomized: bool,         // 随机分配标志
    deadline: i64,           // 过期时间戳
    amount: u64,             // 金额（lamports，不包括租金）
}

行为： - 创建 PDA 账户存储红包数据 - 从创建者转移资金到 PDA - 初始化红包数据结构 - PDA 地址派生自：[program_id, "red_packet", packet_id]

docs.title: ClaimRedPacket
docs.text:
领取红包并接收分配的金额。

账户： - [writable, signer] 领取者账户 - [writable] 红包 PDA 账户 - [] 时钟系统变量

指令数据： 

ClaimRedPacket {
    packet_id: String,        // 唯一标识符
}

要求： - 红包必须存在 - 调用者之前不能领取过 - 红包不能已全部领取 - 红包不能已过期 - 红包必须有剩余金额

分配逻辑：

随机分配： - 使用时钟时间戳、领取者地址、红包 ID 和领取次数生成随机数 - 随机范围：平均金额的 0.1 倍到 1.9 倍 - 最后一个领取者获得全部剩余金额 - 确保每次领取至少 1 lamport

平均分配： - 将剩余金额平均分配给剩余接收者

行为： - 将分配的金额转给领取者 - 更新红包状态 - 将领取者添加到领取者列表

docs.title: RefundExpired
docs.text:
将过期的红包退还给创建者。

账户： - [signer] 创建者账户 - [writable] 红包 PDA 账户 - [] 时钟系统变量

指令数据： 

RefundExpired {
    packet_id: String,        // 唯一标识符
}

要求： - 红包必须存在 - clock.unix_timestamp > deadline: 红包必须已过期 - remaining_amount > 0: 必须有剩余金额 - msg.sender == creator: 只有创建者可以退款

行为： - 将所有剩余金额转给创建者 - 将剩余金额设置为 0

docs.title: RedPacketData
docs.text:
pub struct RedPacketData {
    pub creator: Pubkey,          // 创建者公钥（32 字节）
    pub total_amount: u64,        // 总金额（lamports，8 字节）
    pub remaining_amount: u64,   // 剩余金额（lamports，8 字节）
    pub num_recipients: u32,      // 接收者总数（4 字节）
    pub claimed_count: u32,      // 已领取次数（4 字节）
    pub randomized: bool,          // 随机分配标志（1 字节）
    pub deadline: i64,            // 过期时间戳（8 字节）
    pub packet_id: String,         // 唯一红包标识符（4 + len 字节）
    pub claimers: Vec<Pubkey>,     // 领取者公钥列表（4 + 32*N 字节）
}

账户大小计算： 

pub fn calculate_size(packet_id_len: usize, max_claimers: usize) -> usize {
    32 +  // creator: Pubkey
    8 +   // total_amount: u64
    8 +   // remaining_amount: u64
    4 +   // num_recipients: u32
    4 +   // claimed_count: u32
    1 +   // randomized: bool
    8 +   // deadline: i64
    4 + packet_id_len +  // packet_id: String
    4 + (32 * max_claimers)  // claimers: Vec<Pubkey>
}

常量： - MAX_PACKET_ID_LEN: 64 字符 - MAX_CLAIMERS: 1000 个领取者

红包 PDA 使用以下方式派生：

docs.title: 对比：EVM vs Solana
docs.text: 功能 EVM (Solidity) Solana (Rust) 语言 Solidity Rust 存储 合约存储（映射） PDA 账户 Gas/交易费用 Gas 费用（ETH/BNB） 交易费用（SOL） 随机性 block.prevrandao + block.timestamp 时钟时间戳 + 账户数据 账户模型 基于地址 基于账户（PDA） 数据大小限制 无明确限制 必须计算账户大小 退款机制 直接转账 PDA 到创建者转账 领取跟踪 嵌套映射 账户数据中的向量

docs.title: EVM 合约
docs.text:
1. 重入保护：使用 transfer() 限制 gas，防止重入
  2. 随机性：使用 block.prevrandao（Paris 升级后）获得更好的随机性
  3. 访问控制：仅所有者可用的函数用于紧急情况
  4. 溢出保护：Solidity 0.8.20 内置溢出检查

docs.text:
1. 账户验证：所有账户在使用前都经过验证
  2. PDA 安全：使用 PDA 确保账户所有权
  3. 租金豁免：账户必须保持租金豁免余额
  4. 指令验证：所有指令数据都经过验证
  5. 错误处理：全面的错误类型用于调试

docs.title: 与 X402 协议的集成
docs.text:
两个合约都与 X402 支付协议集成：

  1. 支付验证：后端验证链上交易
  2. 支付要求：服务器通过 X402 头返回支付要求
  3. 链上结算：资金存储在合约中，而非平台钱包
  4. 去中心化：平台不托管资金

docs.title: Nginx 配置
docs.text: 使用 Nginx 作为反向代理的配置说明。

docs.title: Nginx 配置概览
docs.text: 

docs.title: HTTP 到 HTTPS 重定向
docs.text:
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name your-domain.com;
    return 301 https://$server_name$request_uri;
}

docs.title: HTTPS 配置
docs.text:
server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name your-domain.com;

    ssl_certificate /path/to/cert.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /path/to/key.pem;

    # SSL 配置
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
    ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;

    # 代理到后端
    location /api {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:5001;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    # WebSocket 支持
    location /ws {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:5001;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;

        # WebSocket 超时设置
        proxy_read_timeout 86400;
    }

    # 静态文件（前端）
    location / {
        root /path/to/client/build;
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }

    # 文件上传
    client_max_body_size 10M;
}

docs.title: 荣誉等级
docs.text: RushChat 的荣誉等级系统根据用户活跃度和贡献自动计算。

docs.title: 荣誉等级系统概览
docs.text: 

docs.title: 评分机制
docs.text: 荣誉积分由以下因素计算：

docs.title: 1. 在线时长
docs.text:
• 每在线 60 分钟 = 1 分
  • 自动计算，实时更新
  • 累计计算

docs.title: 2. 邀请人数
docs.text:
• 每成功邀请 1 人 = 10 分
  • 在用户注册时立即计算

docs.title: 3. 消息数量
docs.text:
• 每发送 100 条消息 = 1 分
  • 累计计算

docs.title: 4. 消息点赞
docs.text:
• 每个点赞 = 2 分
  • 实时计算

docs.title: 5. 合约推荐
docs.text:
• 每推荐 1 个合约 = 5 分
  • 在推荐时立即计算

docs.title: 6. 推荐评分
docs.text:
• 平均投票分数 × 10
  • 根据其他用户的投票计算

docs.title: 个人资料
docs.text:
• 显示当前荣誉等级
  • 显示等级名称
  • 显示距离下一级所需积分

docs.title: 聊天界面
docs.text:
• 用户名旁显示等级徽章（可选）
  • 不同等级显示不同颜色

docs.title: 等级特权（规划中）
docs.text:
不同等级可能享有不同特权：

  • 特殊标识
  • 优先功能
  • 专属频道
  • 其他福利

docs.title: 积分系统
docs.text: RushChat 的积分系统用于激励用户参与和创建频道。

docs.title: 积分系统概览
docs.text: 

docs.title: 注册奖励
docs.text: 新用户注册时自动获得初始积分。

docs.title: Build 激励
docs.text:
• 每日可领取 1000 积分
  • 每天只能领取一次
  • 需要手动点击领取

docs.title: 邀请奖励
docs.text:
成功邀请注册用户获得：

  • 10,000 积分
  • 5 频道贡献值

docs.title: 频道贡献
docs.text:
通过邀请链接注册的用户，邀请人获得：

  • 5 频道贡献值

频道贡献值用于解锁频道特殊功能（规划中）。

docs.title: 创建频道
docs.text:
• 普通用户：需要 10 万积分，创建消耗 5 万积分
  • Rush高管：免费创建，不消耗积分

docs.title: 其他消耗（规划中）
docs.text:
• 发送特殊消息
  • 使用高级功能
  • 购买虚拟物品

docs.title: 个人资料
docs.text:

  • 显示积分获取历史（规划中）
  • 显示积分消耗记录（规划中）

docs.title: 聊天界面
docs.text:

  • 显示积分变化通知

docs.title: 积分计算
docs.text:

  • 注册奖励立即到账
  • Build 激励每日领取
  • 邀请奖励在用户注册时到账

docs.title: 积分限制
docs.text:
• 积分不能为负数
  • 积分没有上限
  • 积分不能转让（规划中）

docs.title: 红包系统
docs.text: RushChat 支持发送和领取红包，基于智能合约实现。

docs.title: 红包系统概览
docs.text: 

docs.title: EVM 链红包
docs.text: 支持以太坊、BSC、Polygon 等 EVM 链。

docs.title: Solana 红包
docs.text: 支持 Solana 主网。

docs.title: 发送步骤
docs.text:
1. 点击聊天界面的红包图标
  2. 选择红包类型（普通红包/拼手气红包）
  3. 输入红包金额和数量
  4. 选择链（EVM 或 Solana）
  5. 连接钱包
  6. 确认发送

docs.title: 红包设置
docs.text:
• 总金额：红包总金额
  • 数量：红包份数
  • 类型：
  • 普通红包：平均分配
  • 拼手气红包：随机分配

docs.title: 链上交易
docs.text:
• 资金直接转入智能合约
  • 需要支付 Gas 费用
  • 交易确认后红包创建成功

docs.title: 领取步骤
docs.text:
1. 看到红包消息
  2. 点击"领取"按钮
  3. 连接钱包（如果未连接）
  4. 确认领取
  5. 等待链上交易确认

docs.title: 领取限制
docs.text:
• 每个红包只能领取一次
  • 需要支付 Gas 费用（领取时）
  • 必须在有效期内领取

docs.title: 可领取
docs.text:
• 红包还有剩余
  • 用户未领取过
  • 在有效期内

docs.title: 已领完
docs.text:
• 所有份数已被领取
  • 显示领取统计

docs.title: 已过期
docs.text:
• 超过有效期
  • 无法领取

docs.title: 发送记录
docs.text:
• 查看发送的所有红包
  • 显示领取情况
  • 显示总金额和剩余金额

docs.title: 领取记录

docs.title: 语音聊天
docs.text: RushChat 支持私有频道的 WebRTC 语音通话功能。

docs.title: 功能概述
docs.text: 语音聊天允许用户在私有频道中进行实时语音通话，支持多人同时在线、屏幕共享等功能。

docs.title: 语音聊天功能概览
docs.text: 

docs.title: 多人语音通话
docs.text:
• ✅ 支持多人同时在线（无固定上限）
  • ✅ 实时音频传输
  • ✅ 低延迟通信
  • ✅ WebRTC 点对点通信

docs.title: 语音控制
docs.text:
• ✅ 静音/取消静音
  • ✅ 音量控制
  • ✅ 麦克风开关
  • ✅ 房主可以静音其他成员
  • ✅ 房主可以踢出成员

docs.title: 屏幕共享
docs.text:
• ✅ 支持屏幕共享
  • ✅ 实时共享状态通知
  • ✅ 其他成员可以看到共享状态

docs.title: 权限管理
docs.text:
• ✅ 语音聊天房主权限（独立于频道房主）
  • ✅ 频道房主自动接管语音聊天房主权限
  • ✅ 房主可以静音特定用户
  • ✅ 房主可以踢出语音房间成员
  • ✅ 房主可以邀请其他用户加入语音聊天
  • ✅ 房主离开时自动转移权限

docs.title: 邀请功能
docs.text:
• ✅ 语音聊天房主可以邀请其他用户
  • ✅ 被邀请用户会收到通知
  • ✅ 支持接受/拒绝邀请

docs.title: 加入语音房间
docs.text:
1. 进入私有频道
  2. 点击"加入语音"按钮
  3. 允许浏览器访问麦克风
  4. 自动加入语音房间
  5. 系统会通知频道内其他成员

docs.title: 离开语音房间
docs.text:
1. 点击"离开语音"按钮
  2. 或关闭频道页面
  3. 自动断开连接
  4. 如果用户是语音聊天房主，权限会自动转移给其他参与者

docs.title: 邀请其他用户
docs.text:
1. 作为语音聊天房主，点击"邀请"按钮
  2. 选择要邀请的用户
  3. 被邀请用户会收到通知
  4. 被邀请用户可以选择接受或拒绝

docs.title: 管理语音房间
docs.text:
1. 静音成员：房主可以点击成员列表中的静音按钮
  2. 踢出成员：房主可以踢出不活跃或违规的成员
  3. 查看状态：可以查看当前语音聊天的参与者列表

docs.title: WebRTC
docs.text:
使用 WebRTC 技术实现点对点通信：

  • ✅ 低延迟音频传输
  • ✅ 高质量音频编解码
  • ✅ 点对点直连（减少服务器负载）
  • ✅ 自动 NAT 穿透

docs.title: 信令服务器
docs.text:
使用 WebSocket 作为信令服务器：

  • ✅ 建立 WebRTC 连接
  • ✅ 交换 SDP（Session Description Protocol）
  • ✅ 交换 ICE 候选（NAT 穿透）
  • ✅ 实时状态同步
  • ✅ 信令数据转发

docs.title: 状态管理
docs.text:
• ✅ 活跃语音聊天记录
  • ✅ 参与者列表管理
  • ✅ 语音聊天房主管理
  • ✅ 自动权限转移
  • ✅ 状态查询接口

docs.title: 事件系统
docs.text:
支持以下 WebSocket 事件：

  • voice:join - 加入语音聊天
  • voice:leave - 离开语音聊天
  • voice:signal - WebRTC 信令转发
  • voice:mute - 静音操作
  • voice:kick - 踢出操作
  • voice:invite - 邀请加入
  • voice:invite_reject - 拒绝邀请
  • voice:screen_share - 屏幕共享状态
  • voice:status - 查询语音聊天状态
